home.calls.lede: Call from any conversation or drop into a server's voice channel. Calls are encrypted end to end, just like your messages.
home.calls.shareBody: Share a window or your whole screen at its own resolution and up to 60 frames a second, with sound.
home.calls.talkBody: Your microphone is only on while you hold a key, or a button on a touch screen.

home.foot.tagline: End-to-end encrypted chat, calls and servers.
home.hero.fine: Sign up with a username and a password. No email, no phone number.
home.hero.lede: Nexa has servers, voice and video calls, and custom emoji and sticker packs anyone can make. Messages, files and calls are encrypted on your device, so only the people you're talking to can read or hear them.
home.hero.title: Private Chat with All the Fun Left In
home.people.dataBody: Nothing about you is sold or tracked. The Privacy Policy lists every piece of data that is kept.
home.people.lede: No ads, no tracking, fair moderation, and a direct line to the team.
home.people.moderationBody: Every action comes with a reason, says who took it, and gives you a private thread to appeal in.
home.people.reportsBody: Report a problem from inside the app, with a screenshot if it helps, and read the replies there too.

home.people.title: What You Can Count On

home.private.safetyBody: Compare a number or scan a code with a friend to make sure nobody is listening in between.

legal.new3: Deleting an account removes everything it posted and uploaded, whoever deletes it. Deleting your own also deletes your direct message conversations, for both people in them.
legal.new4: New rules against impersonation and against getting around a mute or ban, a minimum age of 13, and a section on how long things are kept.
legal.hlPrivateBody: Messages, files, and calls are encrypted on your device. Nobody who runs Nexa can read them.
legal.hlStaffBody: Public profiles and images, the delivery details the server needs, and moderation cases. Case threads with Nexa are not end-to-end encrypted.
legal.hlModerationBody: Every action comes with a reason, a notice from Nexa naming who acted, and a private thread to appeal in. All of it is logged.
legal.hlRulesBody: Keep it legal, respect copyright, no gore, no hate or harassment, no impersonation, and no abuse of the service.
legal.hlDataBody: No email, no phone number, nothing sold, nothing tracked. The Privacy Policy lists every field that is kept.
legal.aboutLead: Nexa is a chat service where messages, files, and calls are end-to-end encrypted.

moderation.menu.makeAdminBody: Admins can use this panel: act on accounts, read every case and send announcements. It's recorded in the punishment log.
moderation.menu.removeAdminBody: They lose this panel and admin powers at once. It's recorded in the punishment log.
moderation.menu.disableBody: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign back in, without a notice. To tell them why, ban them instead.
moderation.act.avatarDesc: Take down their profile picture, banner or both.
moderation.act.avatarNone: They have no profile picture or banner.
moderation.act.fieldsDesc: Replace their username, display name, about me or pronouns with MODERATOR_REMOVED.
moderation.act.muteDesc: Read-only for a while: no messages, reactions, calls or profile changes.
moderation.act.banDesc: Shut them out of Nexa for a while, or for good. They can still appeal.
moderation.act.deleteDesc: Permanently remove the account and everything it posted, uploaded and owns.
moderation.act.alreadyMuted: Already muted, ending {when}. A new mute replaces it.
moderation.act.alreadyMutedForever: Already muted. A new mute replaces it.
moderation.act.alreadyBanned: Already banned, ending {when}. A new ban replaces it.
moderation.act.alreadyBannedForever: Already banned permanently. A new ban replaces it.
moderation.form.chooseHint: Every action opens a case they can reply to.
moderation.form.resetNote: Each field becomes MODERATOR_REMOVED_ followed by a random code. They can change it again afterwards.
moderation.form.resetUsernameNote: Their username becomes moderator_removed_ followed by a random code (usernames are lowercase). Their old username keeps signing them in, and nobody else can register it.
moderation.form.endsNever: Doesn't end until a moderator lifts it.
moderation.form.muteNote: They can still read everything and appeal in the case thread. They're taken out of any call they're in.
moderation.form.banNote: They're disconnected at once and see only the ban screen, where they can appeal.
moderation.form.reasonPlaceholder: What they did, and which rule it breaks
moderation.form.reasonVisible: They'll see this reason and your name.
moderation.form.notifies: They get a direct message from Nexa and a pop-up.

settings.admin.panelMoved: Browse every account, act on them, work through cases, read the log and send announcements.
settings.security.appLockHint: Once it's on, every device you sign in on asks for a passcode. The passcode never leaves the device you type it on, and it locks your keys there, so closing the tab or locking the app keeps your messages out of reach until you type it again. After ten wrong tries the device forgets your keys, and your password gets you back in.
settings.settings.logOutConfirm: You will need your password to sign back in on this device.
whatsNew.intro: Nexa has been updated. Here is what you can do now.
whatsNew.r20260926.blockBody: When you block someone, you can hide their messages entirely, and replies to them too. Change it any time in Settings under Blocked Users, where everyone you have blocked is listed.
whatsNew.r20260926.bugsBody: Press the bug button in any conversation, on the Friends page or in Settings to tell the Nexa team what broke, with screenshots or a recording. Their replies arrive in your Nexa conversation.
whatsNew.r20260926.channelIconsBody: A channel can have its own icon in place of the # or speaker: a line icon, any emoji, or one of your server's custom emoji. Pick one in the channel's settings.
whatsNew.r20260926.dmGroupsBody: Sort conversations into named groups with Add to Group in a conversation’s menu. Groups can be pinned and collapsed, and still show what is waiting in them.
whatsNew.r20260926.extendBody: Custom CSS and Plugins have their own pages in Settings, where you add them from a link or as code. They are made by other people, not by Nexa, and a plugin can read your messages, so only add ones you trust.
whatsNew.r20260926.foldersBody: Drag a server onto another to make a folder, or choose Add to Folder in a server’s menu. A folder’s menu lets you name it and pick its colour.
whatsNew.r20260926.formattingBody: Press Format Text beside the emoji button to style a message the way you would in a document, on phones too. Messages can now have coloured text, tables, task lists, callouts, highlights and collapsible sections.
whatsNew.r20260926.friendsBody: Profiles show a friend request you have sent, with a way to cancel it, and let you accept or ignore one sent to you. Click anywhere on a friend in your list to open their profile.
whatsNew.r20260926.invitesBody: A link to Nexa in a message now opens right here instead of in a new tab. Invites show the server's banner, who is online, and a button to join.
whatsNew.r20260926.invitesTitle: Invites and Links Open in the App
whatsNew.r20260926.nexaBody: The Nexa conversation now sorts by date with your other conversations, and you can close it like any DM. It comes back when Nexa has something new for you.
whatsNew.r20260926.pinsBody: Pin servers, folders and conversations from their menu. They stay at the top of their list, even when you join a new server.
whatsNew.r20260926.searchBody: The search box above a conversation now searches just that conversation, and “Find or start a conversation” (Ctrl+K) searches everything, with tabs for messages, media, links and files. Your messages are decrypted and indexed on this device only.
whatsNew.r20260926.soloGroupBody: Press Create Group in Select Friends with nobody picked to make a group, then add friends whenever you like.
whatsNew.r20260926.soloGroupTitle: Start a Group on Your Own
whatsNew.r20260926.themesBody: Pick one of 16 new colour themes in Settings under Appearance, or build your own in Simple or Advanced mode. Nexa keeps every piece of text readable.
whatsNew.r20260926.updatesBody: When a new version of Nexa is ready, a prompt in the middle of the screen asks you to reload or update, and it waits for any call, upload or download to finish first.
whatsNew.r20260926.updatesTitle: Know When an Update Is Ready
